lesson: Make product choices that remove high-friction customer work before competitors do.
action_for_founder: Test a complete automated workflow before defending a privacy or architecture constraint.

lesson: Demand is insufficient when users will not pay enough to fund distribution and product work.
action_for_founder: Test willingness to pay and acquisition economics alongside usage growth.

lesson: Validate willingness to pay and commercial path before scaling a technical team.
action_for_founder: Secure committed paid customers before expanding headcount or product scope.

lesson: Treat founder-market understanding and profitability as hypotheses, not assumed strengths.
action_for_founder: Interview and sell to the target users before repeated relaunches.

lesson: A product can grow and still be a poor strategic fit when the market and sales motion are too small.
action_for_founder: Compare addressable market and required sales motion with the firm’s capabilities before continuing investment.

lesson: A viable product path can disappear when sector funding conditions change.
action_for_founder: Set fundraising contingencies and assess sector financing before relying on the next round.

lesson: New categories may face timing, hardware, and capital constraints simultaneously.
action_for_founder: De-risk manufacturing and financing before committing to a new-device strategy.

lesson: Founders need an agreed decision process before conflicts make intuition decisive.
action_for_founder: Document decision rules and revisit them regularly.

lesson: Founder financial and family constraints are operating constraints, not background details.
action_for_founder: Assess founder availability and personal runway before committing to a venture schedule.

lesson: Revenue traction does not resolve structural business-model or defensibility questions.
action_for_founder: Test repeatable margins and a defensibility path before scaling.

lesson: Independent technical verification is necessary when a company-controlled sample establishes the asset value.
action_for_founder: Require independent sampling and qualified review before relying on extraordinary claims.

lesson: Store-level profitability and lease obligations must be tested against an abrupt retail disruption.
action_for_founder: Model store contribution and lease exposure under severe traffic-loss scenarios.

lesson: Customer-asset businesses require independent controls and auditable accounting before scale.
action_for_founder: Segregate duties custody and accounting; independently reconcile customer liabilities and assets.

lesson: An expansion cannot compensate for broken availability and customer-value fundamentals.
action_for_founder: Pilot supply availability pricing and local customer expectations before a rapid rollout.

lesson: Limited sales can justify a pivot but do not establish the underlying causal mechanism on their own.
action_for_founder: Measure repeatable demand and unit economics before scaling production; investigate causes of weak sales separately.

lesson: Production-scale capital needs should be tested against available runway before committing to manufacturing expansion.
action_for_founder: Model working-capital needs and financing contingencies before scaling production.

lesson: A court-supervised reorganization establishes a material distress outcome but not its underlying cause without attributed evidence.
action_for_founder: Use the filing as an escalation signal; do not infer a root cause until sourced evidence supports one.

lesson: A BIA Notice of Intention establishes an insolvency process but does not by itself establish why the business became insolvent.
action_for_founder: Separate legal outcome evidence from any later evidence-supported causal analysis.

lesson: CCAA conversion and workforce reduction document distress and response actions but do not alone establish a causal mechanism.
action_for_founder: Treat court-process records as outcome evidence; require attributable evidence before coding causes.

lesson: A CCAA initial order establishes restructuring status but does not alone prove a business cause.
action_for_founder: Keep outcome evidence separate from causal claims unless the supporting source makes an attributable statement.

lesson: A CCAA initial order and asset process establish a formal distress outcome but not its underlying cause.
action_for_founder: Use court records to verify the outcome and seek separate attributable evidence before coding causes.

lesson: A sudden bankruptcy and closure establish a material outcome but do not establish a root cause.
action_for_founder: Keep outcome evidence separate from causal claims until attributable evidence is available.

lesson: A reported terminal financial constraint establishes distress but not its upstream mechanism.
action_for_founder: Separate a reported inability to continue operating from evidence about why finances deteriorated.

lesson: Liquidity loss can end operations even where a reported balance sheet appears healthy.
action_for_founder: Monitor cash runway separately from balance-sheet measures and document the source of any funding constraint.

lesson: A CCAA initial order establishes restructuring status but does not alone prove a business cause.
action_for_founder: Treat court-process records as outcome evidence and seek attributable evidence before coding causes.

lesson: External price pressure and cross-border tariffs can combine with demand loss in manufacturing.
action_for_founder: Stress-test demand and pricing against import competition and tariff scenarios before relying on a single export market.

lesson: Unexpected operational disruptions and a pandemic can compound hospitality distress.
action_for_founder: Maintain contingency liquidity for interruption and demand-shock scenarios.

lesson: Customer concentration and continuing losses are warning signs that warrant earlier restructuring options.
action_for_founder: Track customer-retention exposure and losses before creditor action forces a sale.

lesson: A BIA NOI and CCAA initial order establish restructuring status but not a causal mechanism.
action_for_founder: Keep formal proceeding evidence separate from causal analysis until attributable evidence is available.
